name: crystalized-ball

frames.best_why: The rim reads all the way round and dense dust fills the lower half without the cursor covering the ball.

tagline: A pink glowing ring encloses violet dust that drifts like a snow globe.
summary: A dark sphere marked only by a bright, slightly broken pink rim, with thousands of tiny lilac particles floating inside. The dust rises and swirls, and follows and scatters when the pointer moves or clicks.
appearance: On a black stage a thin ring of hot pink light draws a circle, brightest near the top and subtly uneven along its length. Inside, fine violet and white specks gather toward the bottom, thinning to scattered points in the upper half.
behaviour: The ring brightens into view while the dust drifts upward, softens, and sways inside the circle. Moving the pointer turns the field and draws the dust after it; a click sends a small shockwave and short bright arcs along the rim.
use_when: A focal decorative object for a dark hero, launch page or event site that needs atmosphere.
avoid_when: It is a canvas visual with no content, needs a sized parent, and only comes alive with a pointer.
customise: Pick a preset for colour and particle feel, or override strands, crackle, glow, spark count, particle count and motion. Size, theme, speed, hover strength and intro are props.
weight_why: Fifteen thousand GPU particles plus field, dust and stir passes every frame.

a11y.note: Canvas is hidden from assistive tech as decoration; reduced motion stops the drift and the click reaction.

issues: The recorded rim reads as a smooth glowing circle rather than the crackling electric edge the description promises.
polish_why: Rich depth and believable dust; the rim stays a bit plain next to the motion inside.
title: Crystalized Ball
